articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Wind Power Prediction Research Based on WOA-BiLSTM-AM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Accurate and reliable probability prediction is a necessary tool to quantify the uncertainty of wind power output, and it is also an important technology to promote the development of new power systems. In this paper, a BiLSTM ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on the Attention mechanism is proposed. This method takes the historical load data as input to model the internal dynamic change law of the learning feature, and introduces the Attention mechanism to give different weights to the implied state of BiLSTM by mapping weighting and learning parameter matrix, so as to reduce the loss of historical information and strengthen the influence of important information. At the same time, aiming at the difficulty of selecting the hyperparameters of the model, the WOA algorithm is proposed to realize the optimization selection of the hyperparameters of the model. The resulting RMSE is 160.6926 and R2 is 0.9771. By comparing the results with four typical predictive models, such as BP, LSTM, Bi-LSTM, and BiLSTM-Attention. It verifies that the Attention-BiLSTM-LSTM neural network method is more accurate and effective, and the WOA-BiLSTM-AM is a good method for ultra-short-term wind power prediction.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model of the Analytical Solution with the Permeance Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Hybrid model based on permeance network and separation of variables method at the air-gap. This study was applied to an outer rotor permanent magnet synchronous motor which is often used in the electric vehicles. The dynamic study of this machine amounts to developing a set of mathematical equations to translate the physical phenomenon considered. We use the permeance network method to establish this system of equations which will be solved with the laws of Kirchhoff. The modeling of the air-gap is the most delicate part, it can be calculated by the finite element method with good precision but it has a drawback which is a significant time. On the other hand the analytical solution is less precise compared to the finite element method but it specifies a low calculation time. The main objective of this hybridization is to retain the advantages of each of these two methods and reduce their disadvantages. For the optimization of the studied motor we calculate the current sheet in the machine in order to solve the demagnetization problem of the poles which may be caused by a large armature current.

Author Keywords: Outer rotor permanent magnet synchronous machine OR-PMSM

articleTitle: Mobility enhance of graphene field effect transistors by organic compound washing
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Due to its excellent properties, graphene attracts many researchers attention. Its single atomic layer properties, make graphene electrical properties are easily affected by surface impurities. In this paper, we studied the doping characteristic changes of the graphene by anhydrous ethanol and acetone cleaning. According to the electrical properties changes of the graphene transistor, we found both the two organic compound washing can reduce the p-type impurities on the graphene, increase the mobility of graphene transistors. The experimental phenomena are that the Dirac point voltage increased by 23 V and 8 V, and the maximum absolute transconductance increased 8.1 μS and 6.9 μS, respectively. This paper analyzes the cause of the experimental phenomena. This finding is helpful to graphene cleaning, improvement of graphene transistors reliability.

articleTitle: Research on characteristic analysis and construction method of 3D digital model of power transmission and transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Combined with the status quo of the digital model of power transmission and transformation equipment, the basic characteristics of the three-dimensional digital model of power transmission and transformation equipment are studied. The main types of power transmission and transformation equipment are introduced. Considering the different states of power transmission and transformation equipment at different stages, the design, construction, operation and maintenance stages are analyzed. The relationship between power transmission and transformation equipment models in design, construction, operation and maintenance stages is studied. The space transformation method of the transmission and transformation multi-medium heterogeneous model is analyzed, together with the model position and orientation registration method. Finally, take the construction of three-dimensional model of transmission line as an example to build the basic unit of the model. The model units are combined and assembled orderly as a whole project. Safety distance collision verification analysis between models can be realized conveniently.

articleTitle: Life prediction of non-polar Dc circuit breaker based on SSA-Elman neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: As an important switching element, non-polar Dc circuit breaker will cause serious consequences to Dc power network and electrical equipment once it cannot be reliably switched off. It is important to study the life prediction model of non-polar Dc circuit breaker to improve the safety of using electricity. To further improve the forecast accuracy of the model, the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) is proposed to optimize the Elman neural network. Firstly, the data at 32A and 63A were processed and analyzed by MATLAB, and it was concluded that the cumulative arc burning energy and the cumulative burning of fixed contact amount acts as input characteristic quantities to the model. Secondly, Elman and SSA-Elman neural network are constructed to predict the electrical life of non-polar Dc circuit breakers. Finally, absolute error, relative error, mean absolute error, root mean square error and mean absolute percentage error are used as evaluation indexes of Elman neural network and SSA-Elman neural network. The results show that the error of SSA-Elman neural network is smaller than that of Elman neural network. The results show that the SSA-Elman neural network prediction model can improve its accuracy.

articleTitle: The influence of gas flow on electrical characteristics of graphene in atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: The surface properties of graphene have a significant impact on its electrical characteristics. In this paper, an approach to change electrical characteristics of graphene by various gases in atmosphere is reported. It is found that the P type impurities on graphene are reduced and transconductances of graphene transistors are enhanced when nitrogen gas, argon gas, oxygen gas or compressed air is blown on the surface of graphene. These phenomena are attributed to the decrease of the surface impurities and carrier scattering rates on the graphene. These results are useful in graphene sensors, devices, and circuits.

articleTitle: A Method Based on Newton-type Algorithm for Sub-Synchronous Oscillation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: A method is proposed in this paper for analyzing sub-synchronous oscillations in renewable energy power systems that are theoretically applicable. The method is based on the establishment of state space equations and eigenvalue calculations and introduces Newton and least squares methods to estimate the parameters of each mode in the signal. The algorithm is tested on two different sets of data. One set consists of a purely computer-generated signal, while the other is obtained from digital simulations on the DIgSILENT/PowerFactory platform. The test results demonstrate the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Using Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS) to explore the fire hazard zone of solar photovoltaic energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: In recent years, due to issues such as air pollution and global warming, green energy such as wind power and photovoltaics has developed rapidly. Moreover, whether it is wind power generation or solar photovoltaic, it is necessary to use energy storage system to regulate the power system to maintain the balance and stability of power supply. However, there have been many fire accidents of energy storage systems in the world, causing difficulties in fire rescue. This study takes Taiwan’s current largest solar photovoltaic energy storage system as a case study, uses the Fire Dynamics Simulator(FDS) to discuss the situation of the fire in this case, the situation of the fire spread, and the fire extinguishing efficiency of the water mist system. Based on the results of FDS computer simulation program, an evaluation method for the fire hazard zone of fire rescue is established, and a mechanism for fire prevention, emergency response and fire rescue of solar photovoltaic energy storage system is established.

articleTitle: Regional Power Grid Load-forecast considering Socio-economic factors
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: In the case of energy interconnection, socio-economic information (population, industrial structure, per capita GNP, etc.) will gradually affect the daily operation of the power grid, that will increase the uncertainty of load forecasting. For this specific situation, This paper proposes a regional power grid load prediction method considering socio-economic information to quantify the influence of relevant socio-economic information on power grid load while meeting the demand of enterprises for prediction accuracy, the method improves the prediction accuracy by constructing the data processing model, social-load relationship model and load prediction model successively. More specifically, the correlation analysis method is used to process socioeconomic data, and quantify the impact of socio-economic information on the grid load through the total factor production model (KLEM) in economics;finally, establish a temporal prediction model based on neural knowledge (Neural Prophet) to improve the predictive performance of the model. Combined with the actual power grid data, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are compared.

articleTitle: Design and research of Red Boat Park intelligent energy management system based on source-grid-load-storage coordination
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: To accelerate the diversification, cleaning, and decarbonization of the energy supply while increasing efficiency, reducing consumption, and promoting electrification, it is urgent to carry out “zero-carbon” demonstration work in the energy sector. This paper investigates the data integration status and energy demand of the Energy Internet at both the supply and consumption links, using the Jiaxing Red Boat Base Zero-Carbon Park as a case study. A system architecture is designed to integrate massive data from the power side, grid side, load side, and energy storage side, utilizing IoT data acquisition and big data analysis technologies. The functional modules of the system are developed and tested, combining the functional requirements of “low carbon, safety, and economy” dispatching business. Various demand response strategies are implemented, promoting flexible resource allocation and creating a “source-grid-load-storage coordination” zero-carbon demonstration area.

articleTitle: Wind Power Prediction Based on GA-optimized BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: With the gradual warming of the global climate, wind energy, as one of the representatives of clean energy, has been rapidly developed in countries worldwide. However, wind power generation has strong intermittency and variability, constantly impacting the stability of the power grid. In order to improve the accuracy of wind power prediction, this paper proposes a BP neural network model optimized by genetic algorithm (GA) for wind power prediction. This model uses GA to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network to improve the computational accuracy and convergence speed of the model, effectively avoiding the problem of a single BP neural network model easily falling into local minima and the slow training speed of GA algorithm. By preprocessing and normalizing meteorological data such as weather, temperature, and wind direction, a wind power prediction model is constructed, and the prediction results show that the model effectively improves the computational accuracy and convergence speed compared to the traditional BP neural network model. This result proves the feasibility of using GA to optimize BP neural network for wind power prediction in this paper.

articleTitle: Novel interpretable wake model using Machine Learning based symbolic regression for wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: The escalating demand for energy, dwindling fossil fuel reserves, shifting fuel prices, and worries about climate change and pollution have prompted the investigation and assessment of renewable energy sources. Among these, wind power has emerged as a particularly promising candidate. However, due to limited suitable locations, wind turbines are often clustered together, necessitating the study of wake aerodynamics to optimize wind farm performance. Understanding and predicting wake characteristics that includes decreased velocity deficit and increased turbulence intensity are crucial for improving the efficiency of downstream turbines. Traditionally, low-fidelity models were used to predict wake characteristics, but recent advancements in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have enabled more accurate predictions, albeit at the cost of increased computational time and resources. Machine learning (ML) has proven to be a valuable tool in addressing complex problems in various engineering domains, leading to the development of ML-based wake models that leverage CFD data for rapid predictions. However, these models have been limited by their reliance on a single wind turbine’s CFD results and their lack of generalizability to other turbines with different blade geometries and operating conditions. In response to these limitations, this study presents a novel wake prediction model using the symbolic regression technique. This innovative approach aims to offer precise aerodynamic performance predictions while maintaining simplicity, interpretability, and generalizability across various wind turbine designs. The proposed model holds significant potential for enhancing wind farm performance by accurately predicting wake characteristics and facilitating better decision-making in turbine placement and operation.

articleTitle: Trust-Based Dynamic Access Control Model for Power Micro-Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Aiming at solving security access control issues such as frequent user authentication and unauthorized access faced by power micro-applications, this paper proposes a dynamic access control model for power micro-applications. This model overcomes the shortcomings of static allocation of traditional access control policies, and applies trust evaluation and access control to micro-applications. User access rights can be dynamically adjusted according to user requests and service status to ensure system security. This paper proposes a multi-level trust evaluation indicators for micro-applications and a trust threshold setting algorithm, which realizes fine-grained dynamic trust perception and dynamic adjustment of user permissions. In addition, through the secondary development of the Application Programming Interface (API) gateway, this paper not only unifies the identity authentication methods between different micro-applications, but also strengthens the existing security protection. Simulation experimental results show that our model can effectively adjust user permissions dynamically, identify potential malicious users, and reject or downgrade access of malicious users, thereby achieving secure access control for power micro-applications and enhancing the security of accessing microservice.

articleTitle: Heavy Ion-Induced Damage in SiC Power MOSFETs with different WJFET
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: In this paper, the failure mechanism caused by heavy ions (Ge) irradiation in Silicon carbide (SiC) power MOSFETs was studied. For 1200V SiC MOSFET irradiated under different bias voltage, failure mode can be divided into three types: leakage current on the order of tens of nA under 200V, leakage current increasing from 200V to 500V caused by high power-density in the channel and N+ region along the current-flowing track, single event burnout over 500V caused by high temperature in the vicinity of N-drift/substrate interface. Besides, cross-sectional view shows damage in the middle of gate oxide for device with wider width of JFET (W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">JFET</inf>) at drain bias 300V. This damage is caused by high electrical field in the oxide, which makes SiC MOSFET with wider JFET region more sensitive to irradiation.

articleTitle: A Web Attack Detection Method Based on DistilBERT and Feature Fusion for Power Micro-Application Server
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: The widespread use of power micro-applications has significantly expanded the attack surface of their server side, thus increasing the risk of vulnerability attacks such as SQL injection, XSS, and CRLF injection. To ensure the security of power systems, these attacks must be detected precisely and timely. Therefore, this paper proposes a server-side web attack detection method based on DistilBERT and feature fusion for HTTP and HTTPS requests. The method treats HTTP and HTTPS requests as text data, specifically, extracts deep semantic features using DistilBERT, and fuses them with well-designed empirical features to comprehensively characterize and classify the request. Consequently, anomalous requests can be detected. The experimental results show that the accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of the method on HTTP CSIC 2010 and FWAF datasets are close to or higher than 99%. Compared with other methods as far as we known, this method has better performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Power Microservices Log Anomaly Detection Based on BiLSTM and BERT with Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: The software industry has seen a rise in the size and intricacy of software in recent years, leading to a growing concern about how to accurately identify, analyze, and pinpoint abnormal behavior that may occur during system operation. Power system microservices are becoming increasingly popular as a way to manage and monitor the complex and distributed attributes of modern power grids. System logs of power system microservices are used to document the status of power system and important occurrences at crucial points in order to help with troubleshooting performance problems and malfunctions, which plays a crucial role in maintaining the stability and reliability of power grids. Traditional anomaly detection methods based on white-box testing require access to the system source code and may not be applicable. Current abnormality detection methods based on system logs primarily focus on extracting log template characteristics, but they pay little attention to the semantic meaning of logs. In order to detect anomalies from system logs more effectively, this work proposes a log execution path anomaly detection method based on Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) with attention. The semantics of log key is also taken into consideration using BERT model for semantic information extraction. Additionally, attention mechanism is used to adjust feature weights at different time steps and select important words. In training phase, a sliding window generates log key sequences from parsed logs to train the model. In detection phase, the model takes as input the parsed log sequence and outputs the probability distribution of the next log key. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method has outperformed conventional approaches on several metrics, including recall rate and F1 score.

articleTitle: Cryogenic carbon capture using efficacious exchange of waste heat energy from flue gas with waste cold energy from LNG
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: Natural Gas (NG) is chilled to −160 degrees Celsius below its boiling point to generate Liquified Natural Gas (LNG), a liquid suitable for transport or storage. The LNG may then be regasified and delivered via distribution pipelines to different end-users or power generation units. Due to the very low temperature at which it is stored, LNG has a significant amount of exergy, which is released during the regasification process (LNG cold energy). Heat from ocean water and additional gas burners are being used for the regasification of LNG to NG especially in Singapore. This practice of dumping available cold energy causes an aquatic microclimate that has detrimental environmental consequences on marine life and is a negative consequence of LNG facilities. Conversely, excessive CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions from flue gas have a substantial impact on the environment and human life. In recent years, there has been a progradation of the necessity to restrict CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions in order to protect the environment. Due to its high CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> recovery rates and high purity, cryogenic carbon capture (CCC) may emerge as a viable alternative to other CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> separation techniques. Producing the cryogenic cold energy required for carbon capture has a downside. The objective of this study is to efficiently use or exchange both waste cold energy from LNG and waste heat energy from flue gas. The cryogenic cold energy from LNG may be utilized to extract CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> from flue gas by liquifying it, while the heat energy from flue gas can be used to regasify LNG. In this simulation, CFD simulations of a shell-and-tube heat exchanger was conducted, taking the phase change of flue gas to liquid flue gas and LNG to NG into consideration. To protect environment, it is conceivable to eliminate the utilization of ocean water and extract CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> from flue gas. This will contribute significantly to achieving Net Zero Carbon Emissions by 2050. Since it is hard to perform real-time experiments in this project because LNG regasification and flue gas capture need diverse industry collaborations and funds, the proof of concept is shown via the use of virtual CFD modeling.

articleTitle: Overview of Wireless Charging Alignment Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: The rise of the electric vehicle industry in recent years has been accompanied by the rapid development of wireless charging technology and its efficiency issues have become increasingly prominent. The alignment detection technology is one of the three core auxiliary technologies of wireless charging technology and is closely related to the wireless charging efficiency issue. This paper firstly reviews the classification of wireless charging alignment detection technologies and related standards, secondly summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of various methods of wireless charging alignment detection at home and abroad, and finally provides an outlook on possible future research directions.

articleTitle: Calculation of life cycle carbon emissions for 110kV transformer station and carbon reduction measures: Taking Guxi Station as an example
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: As an important responsible entity for promoting the energy revolution under the target of carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality, the power industry is exploring ways to save energy and reduce emissions in the five major links of the power system, namely generation, transmission, transformation, distribution, and end-use. As a key place to realize the voltage and current transformation in the power system, the transformer station also grows rapidly with the increase of the whole society’s electricity consumption. This paper studies the carbon emission assessment and carbon reduction measures of a 35kV transformer station in Taixing, Jiangsu Province, China, namely “Guxi Station”, which is to be decommissioned and upgraded in the second half of 2023. The life cycle analysis method and the emission factor method are adopted to trace and evaluate the whole life carbon emission after it is upgraded to 110kV level. The final calculation result is 68794.75 ton, of which carbon emissions in the construction stage account for 81.54%. From the perspectives of equipment carbon reduction, energy supply substitution, and building energy saving, several effective carbon reduction schemes have been proposed, which can reduce the whole life carbon emission by 61770.08 ton.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Development Trends of Distributed Energy Utilization in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Advanced Electronics, Electrical and Green Energy (AEEGE)
abstract: In recent years, China’s rural energy supply guarantee capacity has been continuously enhanced, and the effectiveness of energy structure adjustment has been significant. However, there are problems such as relatively weak infrastructure, extensive energy utilization, and low proportion of clean energy. Aiming at the problems of rural energy development and utilization such as the irrational structure of rural energy consumption and low level of energy consumption in China, focusing on rural domestic energy consumption, this paper combs and analyzes the current situation of rural energy consumption in China, the internal and external situations faced by energy development, analyzes the potential points of replacing fossil energy in various fields of rural production and life, estimates rural carbon sinks and carbon emissions from a multi-dimensional trend, and lays the foundation for studying and judging the “carbon neutrality” capacity of rural energy. In view of the particularity of China’s national conditions and the specific characteristics of different regions, through the study of key issues such as the energy utilization of rural waste, the application of rural energy electrification, and the construction of rural energy service system, it is proposed that rural energy transformation and development is an important means to promote the “carbon neutrality” in rural areas, and proposed measures and suggestions to promote the scientific development of China’s rural energy.
